contexts.text: See Colour. AC 3993:6. AC 9467. DLW 380. SE 6064.
In spiritual things... the snowiness or white is the truth and good which a man supposes that he does from himself, which reflects and rejects from itself the rays of light.
A tall man clad in white, seen. The whiteness was intense. It = those called Noah, who were the first of the Ancient Church.
The white horse. See Horse. AC 5319:end. AC 6534. DSS 12. AR 298. AR 820. AR 826. AE 355.
In (these things) the red = the goods of love; and the white, its truths.
The Holy itself of His Divine Human was the raiment which appeared as the light, and as white glistening ().
See Bright. AC 3812:4. SE 1057.

His hairs were white as clean wool () = the Divine Natural as to truth. In the Word, and in the rituals of the Jewish Church, truth itself was represented by white... the reason of which is that truth is of light.

Speckled and spotted are from black and white... and, in the internal sense, white = truth, properly, the Lord's righteousness and merit, and hence (these) in man. This white is called bright, because it shines from the light which is from the Lord. But in the opposite sense, white = man's own righteousness, or merit; for truth without good is attended with such merit.
As the white and black exist there from the light in which are intelligence and wisdom, and the shade in which these are lacking, it is evident that they (have these significations).
The white among the lambs = the merit which is placed in goods.

Everyone that had white in it () = in which there is truth; for white = truth, but properly the Lord's justice (or righteousness) and merit, and thence the Lord's justice and merit with man. The reason white has this signification, is that the light of Heaven, which is from the Lord, and is the source of resplendence and bright-whiteness = truth; and that which is enlightened by this light, so as to become resplendent and bright-white, is that which is called the Lord's righteousness and merit in man. Illustrated.
Teeth whiter than milk = righteousness, AE 364:4.
To become whiter than snow () = to be purified from sins by the reception and putting on of the Lord's righteousness. (Compare AE 196:2.)

In all these passages, white = the truth of faith... But this is not possessed by those who believe that they have faith from themselves, and are therefore wise from themselves; but by those who believe that they have it from the Lord; for it is to these that faith and wisdom are given... This is to put on white garments, and to be made white in the blood of the Lamb. Further explained.
(Jacob) peeled white peelings in them, to the laying bare of the white that was upon the rods () = the disposing of the interior power of truth... For white = truth.
White garments () = spiritual truths. ( = genuine truths of faith from good. AC 9960:7.)
That white is predicated of truth, because it is from the light of Heaven. References.
Those (Spirits and Angels) appear in white garments who are in truths of faith through which is good; and those in resplendent bright-white garments who are in truths of faith which are from good...
Raiment white as snow, and fine white linen = holy truths; for whiteness and bright-whiteness are predicated of truths, because they the most closely approach light...
His teeth are white with milk () = that the Divine Natural is nothing but the good of truth; for white is predicated of truth. ( = that His Sensuous was Divine truth from Divine good. AE 556:21.)
In Heaven, those in truth of the Natural appear clad in white; and this white appears like that of linen.
Truth is there presented to view as white.

(The manna) was like coriander seed, white () = that the truth therein was pure... For white is predicated of truth; and truth is also represented as white... (These words) describe the quality of the truth...
To make one hair white () = to say, from self, that truth is truth.
The Angels and Spirits who are in genuine truth, appear clad in white garments; and those who are in truths from good, in resplendent ones.
Whiteness, and bright-whiteness are predicated of and correspond to truth. HH 179:end.
White = genuine truth. References.
In proportion as colours partake of white, they = truth.
Blue from white. See Blue.
The whiteness of their garments is from the light of Heaven, which is Divine truth.
The less intelligent (Angels) have bright white, and white garments devoid of resplendence. And the still less intelligent have party-coloured garments.
The colour white corresponds to wisdom.
In the Heavens where wisdom reigns, the light is bright-white, and the Angels there are clad in white linen garments.
I will give him a white stone () = truths favouring and united to good... For white is predicated of truths. ( = wisdom and intelligence. AE 147.)

They shall walk with Me in white () = that they will live with the Lord in His Spiritual Kingdom, because they are in truths from Him... In white = in truths; for, in the Word, white is predicated of truths, because it derives its origin from the light of the sun. ( = their spiritual life, which they have through the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word. In white = in truths... and therefore to walk with Me in white = spiritual life, because this is the life of truth, that is, according to truths. AE 196.)
Shall he clothed in white garments () = become spiritual through truths. ( = intelligence and wisdom according to truths and their reception; for white garments = truths Divine. AE 198.)
(I counsel thee to buy of Me) white garments... () = the genuine truths of wisdom. Explained. AE 243.

The colour white derives its origin from the light of the Sun in Heaven, and thus from spiritual light, which is brightcandida-... And the spiritual Angels, being in the truths of wisdom from the Lord, are in that bright-white light, and therefore they are clothed in white.

Arrayed in white garments () = from the Divine truths of the Word. ( = all the truths from good in the lower Heavens; for white garments = the truths which are to be put on, and which, in special, are memory truths and Knowledges, and the lower Heavens are in these truths. AE 271.)

White robes were given to each of them () = communication with the Angels who were in Divine truths. ( = Divine truth from the Lord with them, and protection... For white is predicated of the truths which are from the Lord; for whiteness is of light, and the light which proceeds from the Lord as a Sun is, in its essence, Divine truth. AE 395.) See AE 395:2.

Clothed in white robes () = communication and conjunction with the higher Heavens. ( = that they are then in truths, and in protection against falsities; for white robes = the reception of Divine truth, and protection against falsities. AE 457.) AR 376. AE 472.
See White, To make.

Behold, a white cloud () = the Word in the sense of the letter such as it is interiorly... because white is predicated of truths in the light; and, interiorly in the sense of the letter there are spiritual truths, which are in the light of Heaven. AE 905.
I saw a great white throne () = ... a universal Judgment... from Divine truths. AR 865:2.
The seats of the third (or lowest) row, were covered with white cloth.
In the midst of the Spirits were some Angels in white.
They who have been regenerated by means of the Divine truth of faith, in Heaven wear white fine linen garments, and are called spiritual Angels.

The fine twined linen was of a snowy colour (which) = what is entire and complete, and consequently corresponds to light, from which comes that bright-whiteness... and consequently to Truths them elves, which are likened to the rays of light. It is from this that a white colour derives the fact that all colours are in it in a becoming and fit manner; just as in the form of Truth, in which all colours must be as it were interwoven, otherwise truth can have no existence...

In the other life, Moors, or Negroes, like [other]. Africans, do not want to be black, but white. After they have been prepared, they esteem whiteness as beauty, because all the Angels... are white; and the interior ones love to be clad in white garments. (These Africans detest the blackness of their bodies; for they know that their souls are white... SE 453:end.)
On those who love white underclothing... They incited me to buy (such), by which is signified that they are those especially who suppose they merit Heaven by their own righteousness.
But a white colour (unlike a black one) does not receive the rays of light, but reflects them; and in like manner do those who justify themselves, and place merit in works...
The reason why, in the Word, white is predicated of truths, is that Divine truth is the light of Heaven, and whiteness is from the light of Heaven. Illustrated.
The Nazarites were whiter than snow, they were whiter than milk () = the truth of the good of celestial love. ( = a representative of Divine truth and Divine good in its perfection. AE 372:5.)
The reason white is predicated of truth, and signifies it, is that white derives its origin from the whiteness of light; and light = truth.

The reason the white robes given those under the altar also = protection by the Lord, is that the white robes which were given them represented the Lord's presence around them with Divine truth, by which He protects them; for He encompasses them with a sphere of light, from which they have the white robes; and when they are encompassed with this sphere they can no longer be infested by evil Spirits... This takes place also with those who are being elevated by the Lord into Heaven: they are then clothed in white garments, which is a sign that they are in Divine truth, and therefore in safety.
The fields are white already for the harvest () = (that a new Church, which is from the Lord, is at hand).

The cloud appeared white () from the shining through of the Divine truth in the Heavens... For all whiteness that appears in the Heavens comes forth from the light of Heaven, which, in its essence, is Divine truth. Hence it is that the Angels, because in Divine truth, are clad in white garments.
